name: Mezaj Maghribhi
note: Saudi cafe chain (Moroccan tea and coffee, drive-thru franchises). Present on the back of several Saudi Pro League shirts (Al-Shabab, Al-Kholood). Al-Shabab history: official sponsor announced 2025-03 (club site, alshabab-sc.sa/blogs/743 - the company was represented by its general manager Mahdi Al-Subaie) and welcomed as a main sponsor on 2025-08-29 (club X post, https://x.com/AlShababSaudiFC/status/1961376935860199922). The franchisor is Mezaj Coffee Company (شركة قهوة مزاج), Riyadh, per the franchising.sa listing (https://franchising.sa/franchise/365/mezaj-mzaj); who owns Mezaj Coffee Company is not sourced, so the sponsor stays not rated yet. Not on the 2026-27 kit record: the back-of-shirt placement for 2026-27 is not confirmed by any text source or clearly identifiable photo. Lead for a future researcher: a manhom.com directory page may name Mezaj Coffee Company's founding partners, but the page sits behind a Cloudflare check and could not be opened.
